informal: Non-coprime Mason–Stothers in char 0: nonzero a+b+c=0 are all constant or max degree < deg rad(a) + deg rad(b) + deg(c).
original: Theorem 5. Let k be any field of characteristic zero, and a, b, c ∈ k[t] be nonzero polynomials satisfying a + b + c = 0. Then we either have a, b, c ∈ k or max{deg(a), deg(b), deg(c)} < deg(rad(a)) + deg(rad(b)) + deg(c).
